title: Where agents help, where they hurt

cells.label: SHIP IT
cells.body: Well-scoped tickets, reversible. Let the agent draft, human approves.

cells.label: DRAFT
cells.body: Exploratory work where speed matters more than being right.

cells.label: REVIEW
cells.body: Stakes are real. Agent proposes, human decides. No auto-merge.

cells.label: DON'T
cells.body: High-stakes and fuzzy. Write the spec yourself first. Then revisit.
